long: Catalyst Cannabis Dispensary Downtown Long Beach is located on Pine Avenue between 4th and 5th streets, close to Downtown Long Beach restaurants, nightlife and Metro access. The licensed dispensary serves recreational customers age 21+ and qualifying medical cannabis patients. Its menu includes flower, vapes, pre-rolls, concentrates, edibles, topicals and tinctures, with online ordering available for in-store pickup. Catalyst displays tax-included prices and accepts debit cards and cash, with an ATM inside. The Pine Avenue store is wheelchair accessible and is supported by on-site security during business hours. The location traces back to Catalyst's Long Beach roots, where the retail brand began in 2020.
